syntax: At most 39 ASCII letters/numbers with single internal hyphens.
methodology: Require a matching login and positive numeric id at HTTP 200. Missing requires HTTP 404 and the exact JSON message Not Found. No verified badge is inferred.

syntax: The app accepts ASCII letters/numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens. Server-side restrictions may produce Unknown.
methodology: Require a matching login and positive numeric id at HTTP 200. Missing requires HTTP 404 and the Gitea user-does-not-exist message, optionally followed by bracketed diagnostic context. No verified badge is inferred.

syntax: Case-sensitive public user ID. The app preserves spelling; server-side restrictions may produce Unknown.
methodology: Require the exact requested id at HTTP 200. Missing requires the literal JSON null at HTTP 200. No verified badge or current account activity is inferred.
